description: Describe a specific Exeris SDK annotation: simple and qualified name, owning package rationale, targets, retention, purpose, detailed description, all attributes (with types, defaults, required-ness, descriptions, and deprecations), and annotation-level deprecation status.

annotation.description: The annotation name to inspect. Accepts simple name (e.g. 'ExerisDomain', 'Field', 'Validation') or fully-qualified name (e.g. 'eu.exeris.sdk.annotation.ExerisDomain'). Case-insensitive.

name: sdk-describe_annotation
